jurisdiction_name: SIL LAKE DIST D (SILVER LAKE VILLAGE Village)
narrative: Sil Lake Dist D (Village of Silver Lake Village) has 509 registered voters, with 47.9% unaffiliated or lacking primary history. Republican-leaning voters make up 26.9% of registrants and Democratic-leaning voters account for 25.1%, a narrow Republican lean of 1.8 percentage points.
